info.title: pgtail
info.description: Interactive PostgreSQL log tailer with auto-detection, filtering, semantic highlighting, and a full screen tail mode.

options.name: --edit
options.description:
Open config in the built-in editor.
--reset Reset to defaults (creates backup).

commands.name: tail
commands.description: Tail logs for a PostgreSQL instance or arbitrary log file(s).

options.name: --file
options.description: Path or glob pattern to tail. Can specify multiple times.

options.name: --stdin
options.description: Read log data from stdin pipe (e.g., cat log.gz | gunzip | pgtail tail --stdin).

options.name: --stream
options.description: Print entries to standard output instead of the full screen view.

arguments.name: INSTANCE_ID
arguments.description: Instance ID to tail (optional if --file or --stdin is used).

options.name: --install-completion
options.description: Install completion for the current shell (bash, zsh, fish, pwsh).

options.name: --show-completion
options.description: Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or customize the installation.
